title: Sample Refund Policy
content:
Fictional Sample Store - Refund Policy

        Customers may request a refund within 7 calendar days
        after receiving an eligible product.

        Products must be unused and returned with their original
        packaging and accessories.

        Refund eligibility is subject to product inspection.
        Approved refunds are returned through the original
        payment method.

        The sample processing period is 5 to 7 business days
        after the returned product passes inspection.

title: Sample Refund Status
content:
Customers can check refund progress through the sample
        store's official order history page.

        Refund stages are:
        1. Refund requested.
        2. Return received.
        3. Product inspection.
        4. Refund approved.
        5. Refund processed.

        Bank processing times may vary. The assistant cannot
        access individual refund records.

title: Sample Order Cancellation Policy
content:
Customers may request cancellation before an order
        is dispatched.

        Orders that have already been dispatched cannot be
        cancelled through the standard cancellation process.
        Customers may instead review the sample return policy.

        Cancellation requests are subject to order status.

title: Sample Cancellation Fees
content:
Fictional Sample Store does not charge a cancellation
        fee for orders cancelled before dispatch.

        Orders already dispatched are not eligible for
        standard cancellation.

        These are demonstration rules only.

title: Sample Shipping Address Policy
content:
Customers may request an address update before
        their order is dispatched.

        Address changes may not be possible after dispatch.

        Customers should review their address carefully
        before confirming an order.

        The assistant cannot directly modify customer accounts.

title: Sample Shipping Methods
content:
Fictional Sample Store provides two shipping options.

        Standard Shipping: Estimated delivery in 5 to 7
        business days.

        Express Shipping: Estimated delivery in 2 to 3
        business days.

        Delivery estimates may vary by destination.

title: Sample Delivery Tracking
content:
Customers can review delivery progress using the
        tracking reference provided in their order confirmation.

        Common tracking statuses include:
        Order confirmed.
        Packed.
        Dispatched.
        In transit.
        Out for delivery.
        Delivered.

        The assistant cannot access live shipment records.

title: Sample Accepted Payment Methods
content:
Fictional Sample Store accepts:
        Credit cards.
        Debit cards.
        UPI.
        Net banking.

        Payment availability may depend on the customer's
        payment provider and transaction conditions.

title: Sample Payment Failure Guidance
content:
If a payment fails, customers should first check
        whether money was deducted from their bank account.

        If money was deducted but the order was not confirmed,
        customers should retain their transaction reference
        and contact the official support channel.

        Never share passwords, PINs, or OTPs.

title: Sample Account Registration
content:
Customers can create an account using the sample
        store's registration page.

        Required information:
        Name.
        Email address.
        Password.

        Customers should use a valid email address and
        create a strong password.

title: Sample Password Recovery
content:
Customers who forget their password can use the
        Forgot Password option on the sample store's
        sign-in page.

        A password reset link is sent to the registered
        email address.

        Customers should never share their password,
        PIN, or OTP with anyone.

title: Sample Newsletter Subscription
content:
Customers can manage newsletter preferences through
        the sample store's newsletter subscription settings.

        Customers can unsubscribe using the unsubscribe
        option included in newsletter emails.

        Changes may take a short time to take effect.
